rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable evidence-supported optimizations. The `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4.4.3` step provides Gradle dependency and wrapper caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), so adding a separate `actions/cache` for `~/.gradle/caches` would be redundant rather than additive. Custom caches already exist for Thomas layouts and odiff. Concurrency control is present (`cancel-in-progress: true` at workflow level; the `screenshots` job intentionally uses `cancel-in-progress: false` because it is serialized with the docs deploy on the `pages` group). Push triggers already filter by relevant paths. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT require representative successful-duration history, but the CI history shows every run is `skipped`, so no timing baseline exists to justify changing the 45-minute timeout. No matrix jobs exist for P-LIT-FAIL-FAST or P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST. Bazel patterns do not apply because this is a Gradle project. Test selection/skipping patterns (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT) would reduce required coverage, and schedule suppression patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) are not suitable because the schedule is intentional for baseline refresh and report pruning. No concrete configuration smell or unused output was identified in the workflow.
